# Metric Management Group

> Multifamily property management company headquartered in Spring, Texas. Metric manages conventional apartments, senior living and student housing communities across six markets: Houston, Dallas, Austin and San Antonio (Texas), Phoenix (Arizona) and Daytona (Florida). It also partners with investors on value-add, core-plus and ground-up multifamily projects.

Contact: info@metricmgmtgroup.com · (832) 885-8091 · (281) 362-5166
Headquarters: 24347 W. Hardy Road, Suite 303, Spring, TX 77373, United States

## Services

- [Management services](https://metricmgmtgroup.com/management): overview of the management approach: analysis and assessment, project management, data-driven marketing, lease-up and sales mobilization.
- [Conventional housing management](https://metricmgmtgroup.com/management/conventional-housing): apartment communities, from modern apartment complexes to high-rise residential buildings.
- [Senior living management](https://metricmgmtgroup.com/management/senior-living): assisted living facilities and independent senior residences.
- [Student housing management](https://metricmgmtgroup.com/management/student-housing): operations, maintenance, security, leasing and resident support for student communities.
